about.title: About Project
about.description: A simple, powerful, and open-source cross-platform batch renaming tool that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
about.bio: Hi! I'm Junyou. This project was created to make tedious file renaming tasks easier. If you find this tool helpful, consider buying me a coffee to support continued development and maintenance!
about.thanks: Thank you for your support and encouragement

basic.title: Basic Workflow
basic.step1: Drag & drop files into the file area or click to select files.
basic.step2: Add rules in the "Rename Pipeline" section.
basic.step4: Preview renamed results in real-time on the right table.
basic.step5: Click "Rename Files" or "Create Copy" once confirmed.

pipeline.title: Rule Order & Pipeline Chaining
pipeline.description: Rules are executed sequentially from top to bottom:
pipeline.point1: The output filename of each rule automatically becomes the input for the next rule.
pipeline.point2: Different rule ordering produces different results. Reorder anytime via drag handles or arrow buttons.
pipeline.tip: Tip: You can temporarily disable any rule by clicking the eye icon without deleting it.

regex.title: Regex Cheat Sheet
regex.description: Regular Expressions (Regex) are powerful text matching tools that help you precisely select the parts of text you want to modify.

table.word: Matches any letter, digit, or underscore
table.star: Matches 0 or more of the preceding character
table.plus: Matches 1 or more of the preceding character
table.caret: Matches the start of the string
table.dollar: Matches the end of the string

numbering.title: Sequential Numbering ($n)
numbering.description: You can use {code} in the "Replace with" field to insert incrementing numbers.
